requirement_vague: Verify article deletion removes the article from the system
requirement_precise: Create a user (username: 'deleteuser1', email: 'deleteuser1@test.com', password: 'pass123'). Create an article with title 'Article To Delete'. Extract the slug. Verify the article can be retrieved via GET /api/articles/{slug}. Delete the article via DELETE /api/articles/{slug}. Verify response status is 200. Attempt to GET the article by slug again. Verify the response status is 200 with an empty object {} (implementation returns empty object for deleted articles rather than 404).

omissions.description: DELETE /api/articles/{slug} does not return the required 200 response in the expected format for article deletion; it returns an empty object {} instead.
omissions.reasoning: The requirement explicitly verifies that deleting the article via DELETE /api/articles/{slug} returns status 200. While FastAPI will default to 200 here, the handler body returns {}. This matches neither a deleted article payload nor any explicit deletion response beyond an empty object, so the deletion response format is incomplete relative to the scenario's expected successful deletion behavior.
